items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Abbey Foster is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: At the time he was playing with, well, I know one of them then. That was a brother like Chiney. Chiney, what he was called Chiney with a drummer with Celeste Ant one time.
Foster, Foster, yeah. Abbey Foster, yes. And he was with Bunk then? Yeah, he was with Bunk Johnson then. Oh, yeah. At that time.
